    # ---------- PDF Loading & Rendering ----------

    def open_pdf(self):
        path = filedialog.askopenfilename(
            title="Open PDF", filetypes=[("PDF files", "*.pdf")]
        )
        if not path:
            return
        try:
            self.pdf_doc = fitz.open(path)
        except Exception as e:
            messagebox.showerror("Error", f"Failed to open PDF:\n{e}")
            return

        self.page_count = self.pdf_doc.page_count
        self.page_index = 0
        self.status.set(f"Loaded: {os.path.basename(path)} | Pages: {self.page_count}")
        self._load_page(self.page_index)

    def _load_page(self, index: int):
        if not self.pdf_doc:
            return
        if index < 0 or index >= self.pdf_doc.page_count:
            return

        page = self.pdf_doc.load_page(index)

        # Render at a higher zoom for better segmentation
        # 2.0 ~ 144 DPI if PDF is ~72 DPI; adjust as needed
        mat = fitz.Matrix(2.0, 2.0)
        pix = page.get_pixmap(matrix=mat, alpha=False)
        pil = pil_from_pixmap(pix).convert("RGB")

        self.base_image = pil
        self.overlay_image = Image.new("RGBA", self.base_image.size, (0, 0, 0, 0))
        self.fills.clear()
        self.last_clicked_region = None
        self._update_region_list() # Clear the list for the new page

        # Segment regions
        self.status.set("Segmenting regions... (this may take a moment)")
        self.update_idletasks()
        self.segmentation = segment_closed_regions(
            self.base_image,
            dilation_radius=self.dilation_radius,
            invert_lines=self.invert_lines,
        )

        num_regions = self.segmentation.num_labels
        self.status.set(
            f"Page {self.page_index + 1}/{self.page_count} | Regions detected: {num_regions} "
            f"(border regions are not fillable)"
        )
        self._refresh_display()

    def prev_page(self):
        if self.pdf_doc and self.page_index > 0:
            self.page_index -= 1
            self._load_page(self.page_index)

    def next_page(self):
        if self.pdf_doc and self.page_index < self.page_count - 1:
            self.page_index += 1
            self._load_page(self.page_index)

    # ---------- Display handling ----------

    def _refresh_display(self):
        if self.base_image is None:
            return
        # Composite base + overlay
        comp = alpha_composite(self.base_image.convert("RGBA"), self.overlay_image)
        self.composited_display = comp

        # Fit to canvas while preserving aspect
        cw = max(self.canvas.winfo_width(), 1)
        ch = max(self.canvas.winfo_height(), 1)
        iw, ih = comp.size

        scale = min(cw / iw, ch / ih) if iw > 0 and ih > 0 else 1
        self.display_scale = scale

        disp = comp.resize((int(iw * scale), int(ih * scale)), Image.Resampling.BILINEAR)
        self.tk_img = ImageTk.PhotoImage(disp)
        self.canvas.delete("all")
        self.canvas.create_image(cw // 2, ch // 2, image=self.tk_img, anchor="center")

    def on_canvas_resize(self, event):
        self._refresh_display()

    # ---------- Interaction ----------

    def _update_region_list(self):
        if not self.region_tree:
            return
        
        # Clear existing items
        for item in self.region_tree.get_children():
            self.region_tree.delete(item)
            
        # Add current fills
        for region_id, rgba in sorted(self.fills.items()):
            color_hex = f"#{rgba[0]:02x}{rgba[1]:02x}{rgba[2]:02x}"
            self.region_tree.insert("", "end", text=f"Region {region_id}", values=(color_hex,), iid=str(region_id))

    def _on_region_select(self, event):
        selection = self.region_tree.selection()
        if not selection:
            return
        
        region_id_str = selection[0]
        self.last_clicked_region = int(region_id_str)
        self.status.set(f"Region {self.last_clicked_region} selected from list.")
        # Optional: Add highlighting logic here in the future
        # self._highlight_region(self.last_clicked_region)

    def pick_color(self):
        initial = "#%02x%02x%02x" % self.current_color[:3]
        color_info = colorchooser.askcolor(title="Pick fill color", color=initial)
        if color_info and color_info[0]:
            r, g, b = color_info[0]
            self.current_color = (int(r), int(g), int(b), 150)

    def on_canvas_click(self, event):
        if self.base_image is None or self.segmentation is None:
            return
        # Map canvas coords -> image coords
        cw = max(self.canvas.winfo_width(), 1)
        ch = max(self.canvas.winfo_height(), 1)
        iw, ih = self.base_image.size
        scale = self.display_scale

        # Image is centered; compute top-left corner
        disp_w, disp_h = int(iw * scale), int(ih * scale)
        x0 = (cw - disp_w) // 2
        y0 = (ch - disp_h) // 2

        x = int((event.x - x0) / scale)
        y = int((event.y - y0) / scale)

        if x < 0 or y < 0 or x >= iw or y >= ih:
            return

        label = int(self.segmentation.label_map[y, x])
        if label == 0:
            self.status.set(
                "Clicked on a line/non-fillable area. Try inside a closed region."
            )
            return

        if label in self.segmentation.border_labels:
            self.status.set(
                "Clicked on a border/background region (outside). Not fillable by default."
            )
            return

        self.last_clicked_region = label
        # Apply/Update fill color for this region
        self.fills[label] = self.current_color
        self._apply_overlay_for_region(label, self.current_color)
        self._refresh_display()
        self._update_region_list() # Update the side panel
        self.status.set(
            f"Filled region {label} with {self.current_color[:3]} (alpha={self.current_color[3]})."
        )

    def _apply_overlay_for_region(
        self, region_id: int, rgba: Tuple[int, int, int, int]
    ):
        """Draw the region mask into overlay_image with the given color."""
        if self.segmentation is None or self.overlay_image is None:
            return
        mask_bool = numpy_mask_from_label(self.segmentation.label_map, region_id)
        mask_L = pil_mask_from_bool(mask_bool)  # 0/255
        color_img = Image.new("RGBA", self.overlay_image.size, rgba)
        # Paste only where mask=255 (region)
        self.overlay_image.paste(color_img, (0, 0), mask_L)

    def undo_last_fill(self):
        if not self.fills:
            self.status.set("Nothing to undo.")
            return
        # Remove the most recently clicked region if available
        if self.last_clicked_region is None:
            # If last region unknown, pop arbitrary last
            if not self.fills: return
            region_id = next(reversed(self.fills))
        else:
            region_id = self.last_clicked_region

        # To undo region 'painting', we need to clear and redraw all remaining fills
        self.fills.pop(region_id, None)
        self.overlay_image = Image.new("RGBA", self.base_image.size, (0, 0, 0, 0))
        for rid, rgba in self.fills.items():
            self._apply_overlay_for_region(rid, rgba)

        self._refresh_display()
        self._update_region_list() # Update the side panel
        self.status.set(f"Undo fill for region {region_id}.")
        # Reset last clicked if we removed it
        self.last_clicked_region = None

    def clear_fills(self):
        if self.base_image is None:
            return
        self.fills.clear()
        self.overlay_image = Image.new("RGBA", self.base_image.size, (0, 0, 0, 0))
        self._refresh_display()
        self._update_region_list() # Update the side panel
        self.status.set("Cleared all fills.")

    def set_dilation(self):
        def apply():
            try:
                val = int(entry.get())
                if val < 0 or val > 10:
                    raise ValueError
            except Exception:
                messagebox.showerror("Error", "Enter an integer in [0..10].")
                return
            self.dilation_radius = val
            top.destroy()
            # Re-segment current page
            if self.base_image is not None:
                self._load_page(self.page_index)

        top = tk.Toplevel(self)
        top.title("Set line dilation (seals small gaps)")
        tk.Label(top, text="Dilation radius (iterations, 0..10):").pack(
            padx=10, pady=10
        )
        entry = tk.Entry(top)
        entry.insert(0, str(self.dilation_radius))
        entry.pack(padx=10, pady=5)
        tk.Button(top, text="Apply", command=apply).pack(pady=10)

    def toggle_invert_lines(self):
        self.invert_lines = not self.invert_lines
        if self.base_image is not None:
            self._load_page(self.page_index)

        disp_w, disp_h = int(iw * scale), int(ih * scale)
        x0 = (cw - disp_w) // 2
        y0 = (ch - disp_h) // 2

        x = int((event.x - x0) / scale)
        y = int((event.y - y0) / scale)

        if x < 0 or y < 0 or x >= iw or y >= ih:
            return

        label = int(self.segmentation.label_map[y, x])
        if label == 0:
            self.status.set(
                "Clicked on a line/non-fillable area. Try inside a closed region."
            )
            return

        if label in self.segmentation.border_labels:
            self.status.set(
                "Clicked on a border/background region (outside). Not fillable by default."
            )
            return

        self.last_clicked_region = label
        # Apply/Update fill color for this region
        self.fills[label] = self.current_color
        self._apply_overlay_for_region(label, self.current_color)
        self._refresh_display()
        self.status.set(
            f"Filled region {label} with {self.current_color[:3]} (alpha={self.current_color[3]})."
        )

    def _apply_overlay_for_region(
        self, region_id: int, rgba: Tuple[int, int, int, int]
    ):
        """Draw the region mask into overlay_image with the given color."""
        if self.segmentation is None or self.overlay_image is None:
            return
        mask_bool = numpy_mask_from_label(self.segmentation.label_map, region_id)
        mask_L = pil_mask_from_bool(mask_bool)  # 0/255
        color_img = Image.new("RGBA", self.overlay_image.size, rgba)
        # Paste only where mask=255 (region)
        self.overlay_image.paste(color_img, (0, 0), mask_L)

    def undo_last_fill(self):
        if not self.fills:
            self.status.set("Nothing to undo.")
            return
        # Remove the most recently clicked region if available
        if self.last_clicked_region is None:
            # If last region unknown, pop arbitrary last
            region_id = next(reversed(self.fills))
        else:
            region_id = self.last_clicked_region

        # To undo region 'painting', we need to clear and redraw all remaining fills
        self.fills.pop(region_id, None)
        self.overlay_image = Image.new("RGBA", self.base_image.size, (0, 0, 0, 0))
        for rid, rgba in self.fills.items():
            self._apply_overlay_for_region(rid, rgba)

        self._refresh_display()
        self.status.set(f"Undo fill for region {region_id}.")
        # Reset last clicked if we removed it
        self.last_clicked_region = None

    def clear_fills(self):
        if self.base_image is None:
            return
        self.fills.clear()
        self.overlay_image = Image.new("RGBA", self.base_image.size, (0, 0, 0, 0))
        self._refresh_display()
        self.status.set("Cleared all fills.")

    def set_dilation(self):
        def apply():
            try:
                val = int(entry.get())
                if val < 0 or val > 10:
                    raise ValueError
            except Exception:
                messagebox.showerror("Error", "Enter an integer in [0..10].")
                return
            self.dilation_radius = val
            top.destroy()
            # Re-segment current page
            if self.base_image is not None:
                self._load_page(self.page_index)

        top = tk.Toplevel(self)
        top.title("Set line dilation (seals small gaps)")
        tk.Label(top, text="Dilation radius (iterations, 0..10):").pack(
            padx=10, pady=10
        )
        entry = tk.Entry(top)
        entry.insert(0, str(self.dilation_radius))
        entry.pack(padx=10, pady=5)
        tk.Button(top, text="Apply", command=apply).pack(pady=10)

    def toggle_invert_lines(self):
        self.invert_lines = not self.invert_lines
        if self.base_image is not None:
            self._load_page(self.page_index)

import io
import os
import sys
import math
import tkinter as tk
from tkinter import filedialog, colorchooser, messagebox
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Dict, Optional, Tuple, Set

import fitz  # PyMuPDF
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageTk, ImageOps
from scipy import ndimage as ndi


# -------------------------
# Utility functions
# -------------------------


def pil_from_pixmap(pix: fitz.Pixmap) -> Image.Image:
    """Convert PyMuPDF Pixmap to PIL Image with alpha if present."""
    if pix.alpha:  # retain transparency if any
        mode = "RGBA"
        data = pix.samples
    else:
        mode = "RGB"
        data = pix.samples
    img = Image.frombytes(mode, (pix.width, pix.height), bytes(data))
    return img


def otsu_threshold(gray_u8: np.ndarray) -> int:
    """Compute Otsu threshold for a uint8 grayscale image. Returns integer threshold [0..255]."""
    hist, bin_edges = np.histogram(gray_u8.flatten(), bins=256, range=(0, 255))
    total = gray_u8.size
    sum_total = np.dot(np.arange(256), hist)

    sumB = 0.0
    wB = 0.0
    var_max = -1.0
    threshold = 127  # fallback

    for t in range(256):
        wB += hist[t]
        if wB == 0:
            continue
        wF = total - wB
        if wF == 0:
            break
        sumB += t * hist[t]
        mB = sumB / wB
        mF = (sum_total - sumB) / wF
        # Between class variance
        var_between = wB * wF * (mB - mF) ** 2
        if var_between > var_max:
            var_max = var_between
            threshold = t
    return threshold


def to_uint8_grayscale(pil_img: Image.Image) -> np.ndarray:
    """Convert PIL image to uint8 grayscale numpy array [H, W]."""
    gray = pil_img.convert("L")
    return np.array(gray, dtype=np.uint8)

def alpha_composite(base_rgba: Image.Image, overlay_rgba: Image.Image) -> Image.Image:
    """Alpha-composite two RGBA PIL images."""
    # Ensure same size
    if base_rgba.size != overlay_rgba.size:
        overlay_rgba = overlay_rgba.resize(base_rgba.size, Image.NEAREST)
    out = base_rgba.copy()
    out.alpha_composite(overlay_rgba)
    return out

def color_tuple_to_rgba(
    color_tuple: Tuple[int, int, int],
    alpha: int = 150
) -> Tuple[int, int, int, int]:
    r, g, b = color_tuple
    return (int(r), int(g), int(b), int(alpha))

def numpy_mask_from_label(label_map: np.ndarray, label_id: int) -> np.ndarray:
    """Return boolean mask where label_map == label_id."""
    return label_map == label_id

def pil_mask_from_bool(mask: np.ndarray) -> Image.Image:
    """Convert boolean mask to single-channel 'L' PIL image (0/255)."""
    return Image.fromarray((mask.astype(np.uint8)) * 255, mode="L")

def safe_make_dir(path: str):
    os.makedirs(path, exist_ok=True)


@dataclass
class PageSegmentation:
    label_map: np.ndarray  # int32 [H, W] region labels (0..N); 0 means no-region (edge)
    num_labels: int
    border_labels: Set[int]  # labels touching borders (usually outside "background" regions)


# -------------------------
# Segmentation
# -------------------------


def segment_closed_regions(
    pil_img: Image.Image,
    dilation_radius: int = 2,
    invert_lines: bool = False
) -> PageSegmentation:
    """
    Segment connected non-line regions:
      1) Convert to grayscale
      2) Threshold to get lines (black) vs background (white)
      3) Dilate lines to seal tiny gaps
      4) Invert to get fillable (non-line) regions
      5) Connected-components labeling on fillable areas
    Returns label_map with labels in [0..num_labels], label 0 is lines/no-fill.
    """
    gray = to_uint8_grayscale(pil_img)

    # Auto-threshold using Otsu; lines should be <= thresh
    t = otsu_threshold(gray)

    # If artwork is inverted (white lines on black background), allow inverting
    if invert_lines:
        line_mask = gray >= t
    else:
        line_mask = gray <= t

    # Seal gaps by dilating lines (morphological dilation)
    if dilation_radius > 0:
        structure = ndi.generate_binary_structure(2, 2)  # 8-connectivity
        line_mask = ndi.binary_dilation(
            line_mask, structure=structure, iterations=dilation_radius
        )

    # Fillable areas are where NOT line
    fillable = ~line_mask

    # Label connected components in fillable mask
    structure = np.array([[1, 1, 1], [1, 1, 1], [1, 1, 1]], dtype=bool)  # 8-connected
    labeled, num = ndi.label(fillable, structure=structure)

    # Identify border-touching labels (usually outside background)
    h, w = labeled.shape
    border = np.concatenate(
        [labeled[0, :], labeled[-1, :], labeled[:, 0], labeled[:, -1]]
    )
    border_labels = set(np.unique(border))
    # Label 0 is non-fillable (lines)
    if 0 in border_labels:
        border_labels.remove(0)

    return PageSegmentation(
        label_map=labeled.astype(np.int32), num_labels=num, border_labels=border_labels
    )

            tree_frame = tk.Frame(left_pane)

            tree_frame.pack(fill=tk.BOTH, expand=True)

            

            self.region_tree = ttk.Treeview(tree_frame, columns=("color",), show="")

            self.region_tree.heading("#0", text="Region ID")

            self.region_tree.heading("color", text="Color")

            self.region_tree.column("#0", width=100, anchor="w")

            self.region_tree.column("color", width=100, anchor="w")

            

            tree_scroll = ttk.Scrollbar(tree_frame, orient="vertical", command=self.region_tree.yview)

            self.region_tree.configure(yscrollcommand=tree_scroll.set)

            

            self.region_tree.pack(side=tk.LEFT, fill=tk.BOTH, expand=True)

            tree_scroll.pack(side=tk.RIGHT, fill=tk.Y)

            

            self.region_tree.bind("<<TreeviewSelect>>", self._on_region_select)

            

            main_pane.add(left_pane, minsize=150)

    

            # Right Pane: Canvas

            self.canvas = tk.Canvas(

                main_pane, bg="#444444", highlightthickness=0, cursor="tcross"

            )

            self.canvas.bind("<Button-1>", self.on_canvas_click)

            self.canvas.bind("<Configure>", self.on_canvas_resize)

            main_pane.add(self.canvas, minsize=400)

            

            main_pane.sash_place(0, 250, 0)

    

            # Status Bar

            self.status = tk.StringVar(value="Open a PDF to begin.")

            status_bar = tk.Label(self, textvariable=self.status, anchor="w")

            status_bar.pack(fill=tk.X)

    

            self.geometry("1200x800")

    

        # ---------- PDF Loading & Rendering ----------

    

        def open_pdf(self):

            path = filedialog.askopenfilename(

                title="Open PDF", filetypes=[("PDF files", "*.pdf")]

            )

            if not path:

                return

            try:

                self.pdf_doc = fitz.open(path)

            except Exception as e:

                messagebox.showerror("Error", f"Failed to open PDF:\n{e}")

                return

    

            self.page_count = self.pdf_doc.page_count

            self.page_index = 0

            self.status.set(f"Loaded: {os.path.basename(path)} | Pages: {self.page_count}")

            self._load_page(self.page_index)

    

        def _load_page(self, index: int):

            if not self.pdf_doc:

                return

            if index < 0 or index >= self.pdf_doc.page_count:

                return

    

            page = self.pdf_doc.load_page(index)

    

            # Render at a higher zoom for better segmentation

            # 2.0 ~ 144 DPI if PDF is ~72 DPI; adjust as needed

            mat = fitz.Matrix(2.0, 2.0)

            pix = page.get_pixmap(matrix=mat, alpha=False)

            pil = pil_from_pixmap(pix).convert("RGB")

    

            self.base_image = pil

            self.overlay_image = Image.new("RGBA", self.base_image.size, (0, 0, 0, 0))

            self.fills.clear()

            self.last_clicked_region = None

            self._update_region_list() # Clear the list for the new page

    

            # Segment regions

            self.status.set("Segmenting regions... (this may take a moment)")

            self.update_idletasks()

            self.segmentation = segment_closed_regions(

                self.base_image,

                dilation_radius=self.dilation_radius,

                invert_lines=self.invert_lines,

            )

    

            num_regions = self.segmentation.num_labels

            self.status.set(

                f"Page {self.page_index + 1}/{self.page_count} | Regions detected: {num_regions} "

                f"(border regions are not fillable)"

            )

            self._refresh_display()

    

        def prev_page(self):

            if self.pdf_doc and self.page_index > 0:

                self.page_index -= 1

                self._load_page(self.page_index)

    

        def next_page(self):

            if self.pdf_doc and self.page_index < self.page_count - 1:

                self.page_index += 1

                self._load_page(self.page_index)

    

        # ---------- Display handling ----------

    

        def _refresh_display(self):

            if self.base_image is None:

                return

            # Composite base + overlay

            comp = alpha_composite(self.base_image.convert("RGBA"), self.overlay_image)

            self.composited_display = comp

    

            # Fit to canvas while preserving aspect

            cw = max(self.canvas.winfo_width(), 1)

            ch = max(self.canvas.winfo_height(), 1)

            iw, ih = comp.size

    

            scale = min(cw / iw, ch / ih) if iw > 0 and ih > 0 else 1

            self.display_scale = scale

    

            disp = comp.resize((int(iw * scale), int(ih * scale)), Image.Resampling.BILINEAR)

            self.tk_img = ImageTk.PhotoImage(disp)

            self.canvas.delete("all")

            self.canvas.create_image(cw // 2, ch // 2, image=self.tk_img, anchor="center")

    

        def on_canvas_resize(self, event):

            self._refresh_display()

    

        # ---------- Interaction ----------

    

        def _update_region_list(self):

            if not self.region_tree:

                return

            

            # Clear existing items

            for item in self.region_tree.get_children():

                self.region_tree.delete(item)

                

            # Add current fills

            for region_id, rgba in sorted(self.fills.items()):

                color_hex = f"#{rgba[0]:02x}{rgba[1]:02x}{rgba[2]:02x}"

                self.region_tree.insert("", "end", text=f"Region {region_id}", values=(color_hex,), iid=str(region_id))

    

        def _on_region_select(self, event):

            selection = self.region_tree.selection()

            if not selection:

                return

            

            region_id_str = selection[0]

            self.last_clicked_region = int(region_id_str)

            self.status.set(f"Region {self.last_clicked_region} selected from list.")

            # Optional: Add highlighting logic here in the future

            # self._highlight_region(self.last_clicked_region)

    

        def pick_color(self):

            initial = "#%02x%02x%02x" % self.current_color[:3]

            color_info = colorchooser.askcolor(title="Pick fill color", color=initial)

            if color_info and color_info[0]:

                r, g, b = color_info[0]

                self.current_color = (int(r), int(g), int(b), 150)

    

        def on_canvas_click(self, event):

            if self.base_image is None or self.segmentation is None:

                return

            # Map canvas coords -> image coords

            cw = max(self.canvas.winfo_width(), 1)

            ch = max(self.canvas.winfo_height(), 1)

            iw, ih = self.base_image.size

            scale = self.display_scale

    

            # Image is centered; compute top-left corner

            disp_w, disp_h = int(iw * scale), int(ih * scale)

            x0 = (cw - disp_w) // 2

            y0 = (ch - disp_h) // 2

    

            x = int((event.x - x0) / scale)

            y = int((event.y - y0) / scale)

    

            if x < 0 or y < 0 or x >= iw or y >= ih:

                return

    

            label = int(self.segmentation.label_map[y, x])

            if label == 0:

                self.status.set(

                    "Clicked on a line/non-fillable area. Try inside a closed region."

                )

                return

    

            if label in self.segmentation.border_labels:

                self.status.set(

                    "Clicked on a border/background region (outside). Not fillable by default."

                )

                return

    

            self.last_clicked_region = label

            # Apply/Update fill color for this region

            self.fills[label] = self.current_color

            self._apply_overlay_for_region(label, self.current_color)

            self._refresh_display()

            self._update_region_list() # Update the side panel

            self.status.set(

                f"Filled region {label} with {self.current_color[:3]} (alpha={self.current_color[3]})."

            )

    

        def _apply_overlay_for_region(

            self, region_id: int, rgba: Tuple[int, int, int, int]

        ):

            """Draw the region mask into overlay_image with the given color."""

            if self.segmentation is None or self.overlay_image is None:

                return

            mask_bool = numpy_mask_from_label(self.segmentation.label_map, region_id)

            mask_L = pil_mask_from_bool(mask_bool)  # 0/255

            color_img = Image.new("RGBA", self.overlay_image.size, rgba)

            # Paste only where mask=255 (region)

            self.overlay_image.paste(color_img, (0, 0), mask_L)

    

        def undo_last_fill(self):

            if not self.fills:

                self.status.set("Nothing to undo.")

                return

            # Remove the most recently clicked region if available

            if self.last_clicked_region is None:

                # If last region unknown, pop arbitrary last

                if not self.fills: return

                region_id = next(reversed(self.fills))

            else:

                region_id = self.last_clicked_region

    

            # To undo region 'painting', we need to clear and redraw all remaining fills

            self.fills.pop(region_id, None)

            self.overlay_image = Image.new("RGBA", self.base_image.size, (0, 0, 0, 0))

            for rid, rgba in self.fills.items():

                self._apply_overlay_for_region(rid, rgba)

    

            self._refresh_display()

            self._update_region_list() # Update the side panel

            self.status.set(f"Undo fill for region {region_id}.")

            # Reset last clicked if we removed it

            self.last_clicked_region = None

    

        def clear_fills(self):

            if self.base_image is None:

                return

            self.fills.clear()

            self.overlay_image = Image.new("RGBA", self.base_image.size, (0, 0, 0, 0))

            self._refresh_display()

            self._update_region_list() # Update the side panel

            self.status.set("Cleared all fills.")

    

        def set_dilation(self):

            def apply():

                try:

                    val = int(entry.get())

                    if val < 0 or val > 10:

                        raise ValueError

                except Exception:

                    messagebox.showerror("Error", "Enter an integer in [0..10].")

                    return

                self.dilation_radius = val

                top.destroy()

                # Re-segment current page

                if self.base_image is not None:

                    self._load_page(self.page_index)

    

            top = tk.Toplevel(self)

            top.title("Set line dilation (seals small gaps)")

            tk.Label(top, text="Dilation radius (iterations, 0..10):").pack(

                padx=10, pady=10

            )

            entry = tk.Entry(top)

            entry.insert(0, str(self.dilation_radius))

            entry.pack(padx=10, pady=5)

            tk.Button(top, text="Apply", command=apply).pack(pady=10)

    

        def toggle_invert_lines(self):

            self.invert_lines = not self.invert_lines

            if self.base_image is not None:

                self._load_page(self.page_index)

    

    # ---------- Export ----------

    def export_current_region_png(self):
        if self.base_image is None or self.segmentation is None:
            messagebox.showinfo("Info", "Load a PDF and click a region first.")
            return
        region_id = self.last_clicked_region
        if region_id is None:
            messagebox.showinfo("Info", "Click a region to select it for export.")
            return

        # Create a transparent RGBA image for just this region
        mask_bool = numpy_mask_from_label(self.segmentation.label_map, region_id)
        mask_L = pil_mask_from_bool(mask_bool)
        rgba = self.fills.get(region_id, self.current_color)

        region_img = Image.new("RGBA", self.base_image.size, (0, 0, 0, 0))
        color_img = Image.new("RGBA", self.base_image.size, rgba)
        region_img.paste(color_img, (0, 0), mask_L)

        path = filedialog.asksaveasfilename(
            title="Save region as PNG",
            defaultextension=".png",
            filetypes=[("PNG image", "*.png")],
            initialfile=f"region_{region_id}.png",
        )
        if not path:
            return
        try:
            region_img.save(path, format="PNG")
            self.status.set(f"Saved current region PNG to {os.path.basename(path)}")
        except Exception as e:
            messagebox.showerror("Error", f"Failed to save PNG:\n{e}")

    def export_all_regions_pngs(self):
        if self.base_image is None or not self.fills:
            messagebox.showinfo("Info", "No colored regions to export.")
            return
        outdir = filedialog.askdirectory(title="Select output directory")
        if not outdir:
            return
        try:
            for region_id, rgba in self.fills.items():
                mask_bool = numpy_mask_from_label(
                    self.segmentation.label_map, region_id
                )
                mask_L = pil_mask_from_bool(mask_bool)
                region_img = Image.new("RGBA", self.base_image.size, (0, 0, 0, 0))
                color_img = Image.new("RGBA", self.base_image.size, rgba)
                region_img.paste(color_img, (0, 0), mask_L)

                fname = f"page{self.page_index+1:02d}_region_{region_id}.png"
                region_img.save(os.path.join(outdir, fname), format="PNG")
            self.status.set(f"Saved {len(self.fills)} region PNGs to {outdir}")
        except Exception as e:
            messagebox.showerror("Error", f"Failed to export region PNGs:\n{e}")

    def export_composite_png(self):
        if self.composited_display is None:
            messagebox.showinfo("Info", "Nothing to export.")
            return
        # Export at full resolution (base + overlay), not the scaled display
        full_comp = alpha_composite(self.base_image.convert("RGBA"), self.overlay_image)
        path = filedialog.asksaveasfilename(
            title="Save composited PNG",
            defaultextension=".png",
            filetypes=[("PNG image", "*.png")],
            initialfile=f"page{self.page_index+1:02d}_composite.png"
        )
        if not path:
            return
        try:
            full_comp.save(path, format="PNG")
            self.status.set(f"Saved composite PNG to {os.path.basename(path)}")
        except Exception as e:
            messagebox.showerror("Error", f"Failed to save PNG:\n{e}")

    def export_current_region_pdf(self):
        """Export current region as a one-page PDF embedding a transparent PNG."""
        if self.base_image is None or self.segmentation is None:
            messagebox.showinfo("Info", "Load a PDF and click a region first.")
            return
        region_id = self.last_clicked_region
        if region_id is None:
            messagebox.showinfo("Info", "Click a region to select it for export.")
            return

        # Build transparent PNG for region
        mask_bool = numpy_mask_from_label(self.segmentation.label_map, region_id)
        mask_L = pil_mask_from_bool(mask_bool)
        rgba = self.fills.get(region_id, self.current_color)
        region_img = Image.new("RGBA", self.base_image.size, (0, 0, 0, 0))
        color_img = Image.new("RGBA", self.base_image.size, rgba)
        region_img.paste(color_img, (0, 0), mask_L)

        # Save to bytes
        png_bytes = io.BytesIO()
        region_img.save(png_bytes, format="PNG")
        png_bytes = png_bytes.getvalue()

        path = filedialog.asksaveasfilename(
            title="Save region as PDF",
            defaultextension=".pdf",
            filetypes=[("PDF", "*.pdf")],
            initialfile=f"page{self.page_index+1:02d}_region_{region_id}.pdf"
        )
        if not path:
            return

        try:
            # Create a PDF with same pixel dimensions mapped 1:1 points
            # (If you want to match original PDF page size in points, you can adapt this.)
            h, w = self.base_image.size[1], self.base_image.size[0]
            doc = fitz.open()
            page = doc.new_page(width=w, height=h)
            rect = fitz.Rect(0, 0, w, h)
            page.insert_image(rect, stream=png_bytes, keep_proportion=False)
            doc.save(path)
            doc.close()
            self.status.set(f"Saved current region PDF to {os.path.basename(path)}")
        except Exception as e:
            messagebox.showerror("Error", f"Failed to save PDF:\n{e}")


# -------------------------
# Main
# -------------------------
if __name__ == "__main__":
    app = ColorFillPDFApp()
    app.mainloop()

class ColorFillPDFApp(tk.Tk):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.title("PDF Region Color Filler (Tkinter)")

        # State
        self.pdf_doc: Optional[fitz.Document] = None
        self.page_index: int = 0
        self.page_count: int = 0

        self.base_image: Optional[Image.Image] = None  # PIL RGB
        self.overlay_image: Optional[Image.Image] = None  # PIL RGBA
        self.composited_display: Optional[Image.Image] = None  # PIL Image for display
        self.tk_img: Optional[ImageTk.PhotoImage] = None

        self.segmentation: Optional[PageSegmentation] = None
        self.current_color: Tuple[int, int, int, int] = (
            255,
            0,
            0,
            150,
        )  # Default semi-transparent red
        self.fills: Dict[int, Tuple[int, int, int, int]] = {}  # region_id -> RGBA
        self.last_clicked_region: Optional[int] = None

        self.display_scale: float = 1.0  # image->canvas scale
        self.dilation_radius: int = 2
        self.invert_lines: bool = False

        # UI
        self.region_tree: Optional[tk.Widget] = None
        self._build_ui()

    # ---------- UI ----------

    def _build_ui(self):
        # Menu bar
        menubar = tk.Menu(self)

        filemenu = tk.Menu(menubar, tearoff=0)
        filemenu.add_command(label="Open PDF...", command=self.open_pdf)
        filemenu.add_separator()
        filemenu.add_command(
            label="Export current region as PNG...",
            command=self.export_current_region_png,
        )
        filemenu.add_command(
            label="Export ALL colored regions as PNGs...",
            command=self.export_all_regions_pngs,
        )
        filemenu.add_command(
            label="Export composited PNG...", command=self.export_composite_png
        )
        filemenu.add_command(
            label="Export current region as PDF...",
            command=self.export_current_region_pdf,
        )
        filemenu.add_separator()
        filemenu.add_command(label="Exit", command=self.quit)
        menubar.add_cascade(label="File", menu=filemenu)

        editmenu = tk.Menu(menubar, tearoff=0)
        editmenu.add_command(label="Pick Color...", command=self.pick_color)
        editmenu.add_command(label="Undo last fill", command=self.undo_last_fill)
        editmenu.add_command(label="Clear all fills", command=self.clear_fills)
        menubar.add_cascade(label="Edit", menu=editmenu)

        pagemenu = tk.Menu(menubar, tearoff=0)
        pagemenu.add_command(label="Previous Page", command=self.prev_page)
        pagemenu.add_command(label="Next Page", command=self.next_page)
        menubar.add_cascade(label="Page", menu=pagemenu)

        options = tk.Menu(menubar, tearoff=0)
        options.add_command(label="Set line dilation...", command=self.set_dilation)
        options.add_command(
            label="Toggle invert lines (white-on-black)",
            command=self.toggle_invert_lines,
        )
        menubar.add_cascade(label="Options", menu=options)

        self.config(menu=menubar)

        # Toolbar
        toolbar = tk.Frame(self)
        tk.Button(toolbar, text="Open PDF...", command=self.open_pdf).pack(
            side=tk.LEFT, padx=4, pady=4
        )
        tk.Button(toolbar, text="Pick Color", command=self.pick_color).pack(
            side=tk.LEFT, padx=4, pady=4
        )
        tk.Button(toolbar, text="Prev Page", command=self.prev_page).pack(
            side=tk.LEFT, padx=4, pady=4
        )
        tk.Button(toolbar, text="Next Page", command=self.next_page).pack(
            side=tk.LEFT, padx=4, pady=4
        )
        tk.Button(toolbar, text="Undo", command=self.undo_last_fill).pack(
            side=tk.LEFT, padx=4, pady=4
        )
        tk.Button(toolbar, text="Clear Fills", command=self.clear_fills).pack(
            side=tk.LEFT, padx=4, pady=4
        )
        tk.Button(
            toolbar, text="Export Region PNG", command=self.export_current_region_png
        ).pack(side=tk.LEFT, padx=4, pady=4)
        tk.Button(
            toolbar, text="Export All PNGs", command=self.export_all_regions_pngs
        ).pack(side=tk.LEFT, padx=4, pady=4)
        tk.Button(
            toolbar, text="Export Composite PNG", command=self.export_composite_png
        ).pack(side=tk.LEFT, padx=4, pady=4)
        tk.Button(
            toolbar, text="Export Region PDF", command=self.export_current_region_pdf
        ).pack(side=tk.LEFT, padx=4, pady=4)
        toolbar.pack(fill=tk.X)

        # Main content area with PanedWindow
        main_pane = tk.PanedWindow(self, orient=tk.HORIZONTAL, sashrelief=tk.RAISED)
        main_pane.pack(fill=tk.BOTH, expand=True)

        # Left Pane: Region List
        left_pane = tk.Frame(main_pane, width=250)
        left_pane.pack_propagate(False)
        
        tk.Label(left_pane, text="Filled Regions", font=("", 10, "bold")).pack(pady=5)
        
        tree_frame = tk.Frame(left_pane)
        tree_frame.pack(fill=tk.BOTH, expand=True)
        
        self.region_tree = ttk.Treeview(tree_frame, columns=("color",), show="")
        self.region_tree.heading("#0", text="Region ID")
        self.region_tree.heading("color", text="Color")
        self.region_tree.column("#0", width=100, anchor="w")
        self.region_tree.column("color", width=100, anchor="w")
        
        tree_scroll = ttk.Scrollbar(tree_frame, orient="vertical", command=self.region_tree.yview)
        self.region_tree.configure(yscrollcommand=tree_scroll.set)
        
        self.region_tree.pack(side=tk.LEFT, fill=tk.BOTH, expand=True)
        tree_scroll.pack(side=tk.RIGHT, fill=tk.Y)
        
        self.region_tree.bind("<<TreeviewSelect>>", self._on_region_select)
        
        main_pane.add(left_pane, minsize=150)

        # Right Pane: Canvas
        self.canvas = tk.Canvas(
            main_pane, bg="#444444", highlightthickness=0, cursor="tcross"
        )
        self.canvas.bind("<Button-1>", self.on_canvas_click)
        self.canvas.bind("<Configure>", self.on_canvas_resize)
        main_pane.add(self.canvas, minsize=400)
        
        main_pane.sash_place(0, 250, 0)

        # Status Bar
        self.status = tk.StringVar(value="Open a PDF to begin.")
        status_bar = tk.Label(self, textvariable=self.status, anchor="w")
        status_bar.pack(fill=tk.X)

        self.geometry("1200x800")

    # ---------- PDF Loading & Rendering ----------

    def open_pdf(self):
        path = filedialog.askopenfilename(
            title="Open PDF", filetypes=[("PDF files", "*.pdf")]
        )
        if not path:
            return
        try:
            self.pdf_doc = fitz.open(path)
        except Exception as e:
            messagebox.showerror("Error", f"Failed to open PDF:\n{e}")
            return

        self.page_count = self.pdf_doc.page_count
        self.page_index = 0
        self.status.set(f"Loaded: {os.path.basename(path)} | Pages: {self.page_count}")
        self._load_page(self.page_index)

    def _load_page(self, index: int):
        if not self.pdf_doc:
            return
        if index < 0 or index >= self.pdf_doc.page_count:
            return

        page = self.pdf_doc.load_page(index)

        # Render at a higher zoom for better segmentation
        # 2.0 ~ 144 DPI if PDF is ~72 DPI; adjust as needed
        mat = fitz.Matrix(2.0, 2.0)
        pix = page.get_pixmap(matrix=mat, alpha=False)
        pil = pil_from_pixmap(pix).convert("RGB")

        self.base_image = pil
        self.overlay_image = Image.new("RGBA", self.base_image.size, (0, 0, 0, 0))
        self.fills.clear()
        self.last_clicked_region = None
        self._update_region_list() # Clear the list for the new page

        # Segment regions
        self.status.set("Segmenting regions... (this may take a moment)")
        self.update_idletasks()
        self.segmentation = segment_closed_regions(
            self.base_image,
            dilation_radius=self.dilation_radius,
            invert_lines=self.invert_lines,
        )

        num_regions = self.segmentation.num_labels
        self.status.set(
            f"Page {self.page_index + 1}/{self.page_count} | Regions detected: {num_regions} "
            f"(border regions are not fillable)"
        )
        self._refresh_display()

    def prev_page(self):
        if self.pdf_doc and self.page_index > 0:
            self.page_index -= 1
            self._load_page(self.page_index)

    def next_page(self):
        if self.pdf_doc and self.page_index < self.page_count - 1:
            self.page_index += 1
            self._load_page(self.page_index)

    # ---------- Display handling ----------

    def _refresh_display(self):
        if self.base_image is None:
            return
        # Composite base + overlay
        comp = alpha_composite(self.base_image.convert("RGBA"), self.overlay_image)
        self.composited_display = comp

        # Fit to canvas while preserving aspect
        cw = max(self.canvas.winfo_width(), 1)
        ch = max(self.canvas.winfo_height(), 1)
        iw, ih = comp.size

        scale = min(cw / iw, ch / ih) if iw > 0 and ih > 0 else 1
        self.display_scale = scale

        disp = comp.resize((int(iw * scale), int(ih * scale)), Image.Resampling.BILINEAR)
        self.tk_img = ImageTk.PhotoImage(disp)
        self.canvas.delete("all")
        self.canvas.create_image(cw // 2, ch // 2, image=self.tk_img, anchor="center")

    def on_canvas_resize(self, event):
        self._refresh_display()

    # ---------- Interaction ----------

    def _update_region_list(self):
        if not self.region_tree:
            return
        
        # Clear existing items
        for item in self.region_tree.get_children():
            self.region_tree.delete(item)
            
        # Add current fills
        for region_id, rgba in sorted(self.fills.items()):
            color_hex = f"#{rgba[0]:02x}{rgba[1]:02x}{rgba[2]:02x}"
            self.region_tree.insert("", "end", text=f"Region {region_id}", values=(color_hex,), iid=str(region_id))

    def _on_region_select(self, event):
        selection = self.region_tree.selection()
        if not selection:
            return
        
        region_id_str = selection[0]
        self.last_clicked_region = int(region_id_str)
        self.status.set(f"Region {self.last_clicked_region} selected from list.")
        # Optional: Add highlighting logic here in the future
        # self._highlight_region(self.last_clicked_region)

    def pick_color(self):
        initial = "#%02x%02x%02x" % self.current_color[:3]
        color_info = colorchooser.askcolor(title="Pick fill color", color=initial)
        if color_info and color_info[0]:
            r, g, b = color_info[0]
            self.current_color = (int(r), int(g), int(b), 150)

    def on_canvas_click(self, event):
        if self.base_image is None or self.segmentation is None:
            return
        # Map canvas coords -> image coords
        cw = max(self.canvas.winfo_width(), 1)
        ch = max(self.canvas.winfo_height(), 1)
        iw, ih = self.base_image.size
        scale = self.display_scale

        # Image is centered; compute top-left corner
        disp_w, disp_h = int(iw * scale), int(ih * scale)
        x0 = (cw - disp_w) // 2
        y0 = (ch - disp_h) // 2

        x = int((event.x - x0) / scale)
        y = int((event.y - y0) / scale)

        if x < 0 or y < 0 or x >= iw or y >= ih:
            return

        label = int(self.segmentation.label_map[y, x])
        if label == 0:
            self.status.set(
                "Clicked on a line/non-fillable area. Try inside a closed region."
            )
            return

        if label in self.segmentation.border_labels:
            self.status.set(
                "Clicked on a border/background region (outside). Not fillable by default."
            )
            return

        self.last_clicked_region = label
        # Apply/Update fill color for this region
        self.fills[label] = self.current_color
        self._apply_overlay_for_region(label, self.current_color)
        self._refresh_display()
        self._update_region_list() # Update the side panel
        self.status.set(
            f"Filled region {label} with {self.current_color[:3]} (alpha={self.current_color[3]})."
        )

    def _apply_overlay_for_region(
        self, region_id: int, rgba: Tuple[int, int, int, int]
    ):
        """Draw the region mask into overlay_image with the given color."""
        if self.segmentation is None or self.overlay_image is None:
            return
        mask_bool = numpy_mask_from_label(self.segmentation.label_map, region_id)
        mask_L = pil_mask_from_bool(mask_bool)  # 0/255
        color_img = Image.new("RGBA", self.overlay_image.size, rgba)
        # Paste only where mask=255 (region)
        self.overlay_image.paste(color_img, (0, 0), mask_L)

    def undo_last_fill(self):
        if not self.fills:
            self.status.set("Nothing to undo.")
            return
        # Remove the most recently clicked region if available
        if self.last_clicked_region is None:
            # If last region unknown, pop arbitrary last
            if not self.fills: return
            region_id = next(reversed(self.fills))
        else:
            region_id = self.last_clicked_region

        # To undo region 'painting', we need to clear and redraw all remaining fills
        self.fills.pop(region_id, None)
        self.overlay_image = Image.new("RGBA", self.base_image.size, (0, 0, 0, 0))
        for rid, rgba in self.fills.items():
            self._apply_overlay_for_region(rid, rgba)

        self._refresh_display()
        self._update_region_list() # Update the side panel
        self.status.set(f"Undo fill for region {region_id}.")
        # Reset last clicked if we removed it
        self.last_clicked_region = None

    def clear_fills(self):
        if self.base_image is None:
            return
        self.fills.clear()
        self.overlay_image = Image.new("RGBA", self.base_image.size, (0, 0, 0, 0))
        self._refresh_display()
        self._update_region_list() # Update the side panel
        self.status.set("Cleared all fills.")

    def set_dilation(self):
        def apply():
            try:
                val = int(entry.get())
                if val < 0 or val > 10:
                    raise ValueError
            except Exception:
                messagebox.showerror("Error", "Enter an integer in [0..10].")
                return
            self.dilation_radius = val
            top.destroy()
            # Re-segment current page
            if self.base_image is not None:
                self._load_page(self.page_index)

        top = tk.Toplevel(self)
        top.title("Set line dilation (seals small gaps)")
        tk.Label(top, text="Dilation radius (iterations, 0..10):").pack(
            padx=10, pady=10
        )
        entry = tk.Entry(top)
        entry.insert(0, str(self.dilation_radius))
        entry.pack(padx=10, pady=5)
        tk.Button(top, text="Apply", command=apply).pack(pady=10)

    def toggle_invert_lines(self):
        self.invert_lines = not self.invert_lines
        if self.base_image is not None:
            self._load_page(self.page_index)

    # ---------- Export ----------

    def export_current_region_png(self):
        if self.base_image is None or self.segmentation is None:
            messagebox.showinfo("Info", "Load a PDF and click a region first.")
            return
        region_id = self.last_clicked_region
        if region_id is None:
            messagebox.showinfo("Info", "Click a region to select it for export.")
            return

        # Create a transparent RGBA image for just this region
        mask_bool = numpy_mask_from_label(self.segmentation.label_map, region_id)
        mask_L = pil_mask_from_bool(mask_bool)
        rgba = self.fills.get(region_id, self.current_color)

        region_img = Image.new("RGBA", self.base_image.size, (0, 0, 0, 0))
        color_img = Image.new("RGBA", self.base_image.size, rgba)
        region_img.paste(color_img, (0, 0), mask_L)

        path = filedialog.asksaveasfilename(
            title="Save region as PNG",
            defaultextension=".png",
            filetypes=[("PNG image", "*.png")],
            initialfile=f"region_{region_id}.png",
        )
        if not path:
            return
        try:
            region_img.save(path, format="PNG")
            self.status.set(f"Saved current region PNG to {os.path.basename(path)}")
        except Exception as e:
            messagebox.showerror("Error", f"Failed to save PNG:\n{e}")

    def export_all_regions_pngs(self):
        if self.base_image is None or not self.fills:
            messagebox.showinfo("Info", "No colored regions to export.")
            return
        outdir = filedialog.askdirectory(title="Select output directory")
        if not outdir:
            return
        try:
            for region_id, rgba in self.fills.items():
                mask_bool = numpy_mask_from_label(
                    self.segmentation.label_map, region_id
                )
                mask_L = pil_mask_from_bool(mask_bool)
                region_img = Image.new("RGBA", self.base_image.size, (0, 0, 0, 0))
                color_img = Image.new("RGBA", self.base_image.size, rgba)
                region_img.paste(color_img, (0, 0), mask_L)

                fname = f"page{self.page_index+1:02d}_region_{region_id}.png"
                region_img.save(os.path.join(outdir, fname), format="PNG")
            self.status.set(f"Saved {len(self.fills)} region PNGs to {outdir}")
        except Exception as e:
            messagebox.showerror("Error", f"Failed to export region PNGs:\n{e}")

    def export_composite_png(self):
        if self.composited_display is None:
            messagebox.showinfo("Info", "Nothing to export.")
            return
        # Export at full resolution (base + overlay), not the scaled display
        full_comp = alpha_composite(self.base_image.convert("RGBA"), self.overlay_image)
        path = filedialog.asksaveasfilename(
            title="Save composited PNG",
            defaultextension=".png",
            filetypes=[("PNG image", "*.png")],
            initialfile=f"page{self.page_index+1:02d}_composite.png"
        )
        if not path:
            return
        try:
            full_comp.save(path, format="PNG")
            self.status.set(f"Saved composite PNG to {os.path.basename(path)}")
        except Exception as e:
            messagebox.showerror("Error", f"Failed to save PNG:\n{e}")

    def export_current_region_pdf(self):
        """Export current region as a one-page PDF embedding a transparent PNG."""
        if self.base_image is None or self.segmentation is None:
            messagebox.showinfo("Info", "Load a PDF and click a region first.")
            return
        region_id = self.last_clicked_region
        if region_id is None:
            messagebox.showinfo("Info", "Click a region to select it for export.")
            return

        # Build transparent PNG for region
        mask_bool = numpy_mask_from_label(self.segmentation.label_map, region_id)
        mask_L = pil_mask_from_bool(mask_bool)
        rgba = self.fills.get(region_id, self.current_color)
        region_img = Image.new("RGBA", self.base_image.size, (0, 0, 0, 0))
        color_img = Image.new("RGBA", self.base_image.size, rgba)
        region_img.paste(color_img, (0, 0), mask_L)

        # Save to bytes
        png_bytes = io.BytesIO()
        region_img.save(png_bytes, format="PNG")
        png_bytes = png_bytes.getvalue()

        path = filedialog.asksaveasfilename(
            title="Save region as PDF",
            defaultextension=".pdf",
            filetypes=[("PDF", "*.pdf")],
            initialfile=f"page{self.page_index+1:02d}_region_{region_id}.pdf"
        )
        if not path:
            return

        try:
            # Create a PDF with same pixel dimensions mapped 1:1 points
            # (If you want to match original PDF page size in points, you can adapt this.)
            h, w = self.base_image.size[1], self.base_image.size[0]

            doc.save(path)
            doc.close()
            self.status.set(f"Saved current region PDF to {os.path.basename(path)}")
        except Exception as e:
            messagebox.showerror("Error", f"Failed to save PDF:\n{e}")

        def _on_region_select(self, event):

            selection = self.region_tree.selection()

            if not selection:

                return

            

            region_id_str = selection[0]

            self.last_clicked_region = int(region_id_str)

            self.status.set(f"Region {self.last_clicked_region} selected from list.")

            # Optional: Add highlighting logic here in the future

            # self._highlight_region(self.last_clicked_region)

    

        def pick_color(self):

            initial = "#%02x%02x%02x" % self.current_color[:3]

            color_info = colorchooser.askcolor(title="Pick fill color", color=initial)

            if color_info and color_info[0]:

                r, g, b = color_info[0]

                self.current_color = (int(r), int(g), int(b), 150)

    

        def on_canvas_click(self, event):

            if self.base_image is None or self.segmentation is None:

                return

            # Map canvas coords -> image coords

            cw = max(self.canvas.winfo_width(), 1)

            ch = max(self.canvas.winfo_height(), 1)

            iw, ih = self.base_image.size

            scale = self.display_scale

    

            # Image is centered; compute top-left corner

            disp_w, disp_h = int(iw * scale), int(ih * scale)

            x0 = (cw - disp_w) // 2

            y0 = (ch - disp_h) // 2

    

            x = int((event.x - x0) / scale)

            y = int((event.y - y0) / scale)

    

            if x < 0 or y < 0 or x >= iw or y >= ih:

                return

    

            label = int(self.segmentation.label_map[y, x])

            if label == 0:

                self.status.set(

                    "Clicked on a line/non-fillable area. Try inside a closed region."

                )

                return

    

            if label in self.segmentation.border_labels:

                self.status.set(

                    "Clicked on a border/background region (outside). Not fillable by default."

                )

                return

    

            self.last_clicked_region = label

            # Apply/Update fill color for this region

            self.fills[label] = self.current_color

            self._apply_overlay_for_region(label, self.current_color)

            self._refresh_display()

            self._update_region_list() # Update the side panel

            self.status.set(

                f"Filled region {label} with {self.current_color[:3]} (alpha={self.current_color[3]})."

            )

    

        def _apply_overlay_for_region(

            self, region_id: int, rgba: Tuple[int, int, int, int]

        ):

            """Draw the region mask into overlay_image with the given color."""

            if self.segmentation is None or self.overlay_image is None:

                return

            mask_bool = numpy_mask_from_label(self.segmentation.label_map, region_id)

            mask_L = pil_mask_from_bool(mask_bool)  # 0/255

            color_img = Image.new("RGBA", self.overlay_image.size, rgba)

            # Paste only where mask=255 (region)

            self.overlay_image.paste(color_img, (0, 0), mask_L)

    

        def undo_last_fill(self):

            if not self.fills:

                self.status.set("Nothing to undo.")

                return

            # Remove the most recently clicked region if available

            if self.last_clicked_region is None:

                # If last region unknown, pop arbitrary last

                if not self.fills: return

                region_id = next(reversed(self.fills))

            else:

                region_id = self.last_clicked_region

    

            # To undo region 'painting', we need to clear and redraw all remaining fills

            self.fills.pop(region_id, None)

            self.overlay_image = Image.new("RGBA", self.base_image.size, (0, 0, 0, 0))

            for rid, rgba in self.fills.items():

                self._apply_overlay_for_region(rid, rgba)

    

            self._refresh_display()

            self._update_region_list() # Update the side panel

            self.status.set(f"Undo fill for region {region_id}.")

            # Reset last clicked if we removed it

            self.last_clicked_region = None

    

        def clear_fills(self):

            if self.base_image is None:

                return

            self.fills.clear()

            self.overlay_image = Image.new("RGBA", self.base_image.size, (0, 0, 0, 0))

            self._refresh_display()

            self._update_region_list() # Update the side panel

            self.status.set("Cleared all fills.")

    

        def set_dilation(self):

            def apply():

                try:

                    val = int(entry.get())

                    if val < 0 or val > 10:

                        raise ValueError

                except Exception:

                    messagebox.showerror("Error", "Enter an integer in [0..10].")

                    return

                self.dilation_radius = val

                top.destroy()

                # Re-segment current page

                if self.base_image is not None:

                    self._load_page(self.page_index)

    

            top = tk.Toplevel(self)

            top.title("Set line dilation (seals small gaps)")

            tk.Label(top, text="Dilation radius (iterations, 0..10):").pack(

                padx=10, pady=10

            )

            entry = tk.Entry(top)

            entry.insert(0, str(self.dilation_radius))

            entry.pack(padx=10, pady=5)

            tk.Button(top, text="Apply", command=apply).pack(pady=10)

    

        def toggle_invert_lines(self):

            self.invert_lines = not self.invert_lines

            if self.base_image is not None:

                self._load_page(self.page_index)

def _add_new_group(self):
        # 1. Ask for name
        name = tk.simpledialog.askstring("New Color Group", "Enter a name for the new group:", parent=self)
        if not name:
            return

        # 2. Ask for color
        color_info = colorchooser.askcolor(title=f"Pick color for '{name}'")
        if not color_info or not color_info[0]:
            return
        
        r, g, b = color_info[0]
        rgba = (int(r), int(g), int(b), 150) # Use default alpha

        # 3. Create and add group
        group_id = f"group_{time.time()}" 
        new_group = {
            "id": group_id,
            "name": name,
            "color": rgba,
            "regions": set()
        }
        self.color_groups.append(new_group)
        self._update_region_list()
        self.region_tree.selection_set(group_id)

    def _rename_selected_group(self):
        messagebox.showinfo("Not Implemented", "This feature will be implemented in a future step.")

    def _delete_selected_group(self):
        messagebox.showinfo("Not Implemented", "This feature will be implemented in a future step.")

    def _remove_selected_region(self):
        messagebox.showinfo("Not Implemented", "This feature will be implemented in a future step.")

    # ---------- PDF Loading & Rendering ----------

    def open_pdf(self):
        path = filedialog.askopenfilename(
            title="Open PDF", filetypes=[("PDF files", "*.pdf")]
        )
        if not path:
            return
        try:
            self.pdf_doc = fitz.open(path)
        except Exception as e:
            messagebox.showerror("Error", f"Failed to open PDF:\n{e}")
            return

        self.page_count = self.pdf_doc.page_count
        self.page_index = 0
        self.status.set(f"Loaded: {os.path.basename(path)} | Pages: {self.page_count}")
        self._load_page(self.page_index)

    def _load_page(self, index: int):
        if not self.pdf_doc:
            return
        if index < 0 or index >= self.pdf_doc.page_count:
            return

        page = self.pdf_doc.load_page(index)

        mat = fitz.Matrix(2.0, 2.0)
        pix = page.get_pixmap(matrix=mat, alpha=False)
        pil = pil_from_pixmap(pix).convert("RGB")

        self.base_image = pil
        self.overlay_image = Image.new("RGBA", self.base_image.size, (0, 0, 0, 0))
        self.color_groups.clear()
        self.last_clicked_region = None
        self.active_color_group_id = None
        self._update_region_list()

        self.status.set("Segmenting regions... (this may take a moment)")
        self.update_idletasks()
        self.segmentation = segment_closed_regions(
            self.base_image,
            dilation_radius=self.dilation_radius,
            invert_lines=self.invert_lines,
        )

        num_regions = self.segmentation.num_labels
        self.status.set(
            f"Page {self.page_index + 1}/{self.page_count} | Regions detected: {num_regions} "
            f"(border regions are not fillable)"
        )
        self._refresh_display()

    def prev_page(self):
        if self.pdf_doc and self.page_index > 0:
            self.page_index -= 1
            self._load_page(self.page_index)

    def next_page(self):
        if self.pdf_doc and self.page_index < self.page_count - 1:
            self.page_index += 1
            self._load_page(self.page_index)

    # ---------- Display handling ----------

    def _refresh_display(self):
        if self.base_image is None:
            return
        comp = alpha_composite(self.base_image.convert("RGBA"), self.overlay_image)
        self.composited_display = comp

        cw = max(self.canvas.winfo_width(), 1)
        ch = max(self.canvas.winfo_height(), 1)
        iw, ih = comp.size

        scale = min(cw / iw, ch / ih) if iw > 0 and ih > 0 else 1
        self.display_scale = scale

        disp = comp.resize((int(iw * scale), int(ih * scale)), Image.Resampling.BILINEAR)
        self.tk_img = ImageTk.PhotoImage(disp)
        self.canvas.delete("all")
        self.canvas.create_image(cw // 2, ch // 2, image=self.tk_img, anchor="center")

    def on_canvas_resize(self, event):
        self._refresh_display()

    # ---------- Interaction ----------

    def _update_region_list(self):
        if not self.region_tree:
            return
        
        for item in self.region_tree.get_children():
            self.region_tree.delete(item)
            
        for group in self.color_groups:
            color_hex = f"#{group['color'][0]:02x}{group['color'][1]:02x}{group['color'][2]:02x}"
            group_node = self.region_tree.insert(
                "", "end", iid=group['id'], text=group['name'], values=(color_hex,)
            )
            for region_id in sorted(list(group['regions'])):
                self.region_tree.insert(group_node, "end", text=f"  Area {region_id}", iid=f"region_{region_id}")

    def _on_region_select(self, event):
        selection = self.region_tree.selection()
        if not selection:
            return
        
        selected_id = selection[0]
        if selected_id.startswith("group_"):
            self.active_color_group_id = selected_id
            self.last_clicked_region = None
            self.status.set(f"Active group set to: '{self.region_tree.item(selected_id, 'text')}'. Click on the PDF to add regions.")
        elif selected_id.startswith("region_"):
            self.last_clicked_region = int(selected_id.split("_")[1])
            parent_id = self.region_tree.parent(selected_id)
            if parent_id:
                self.active_color_group_id = parent_id
            self.status.set(f"Region {self.last_clicked_region} selected for export.")

    def pick_color(self):
        messagebox.showinfo("Info", "To set a color, create a 'New Group' and choose the color for that group.")

    def on_canvas_click(self, event):
        if self.base_image is None or self.segmentation is None:
            return

        if not self.active_color_group_id:
            messagebox.showwarning("No Group Selected", "Please create and select a Color Group from the list before filling areas.")
            return

        active_group = next((g for g in self.color_groups if g['id'] == self.active_color_group_id), None)
        if not active_group:
            messagebox.showerror("Error", "Could not find the active color group. Please re-select it.")
            return

        cw = max(self.canvas.winfo_width(), 1)
        ch = max(self.canvas.winfo_height(), 1)
        iw, ih = self.base_image.size
        scale = self.display_scale

        disp_w, disp_h = int(iw * scale), int(ih * scale)
        x0 = (cw - disp_w) // 2
        y0 = (ch - disp_h) // 2

        x = int((event.x - x0) / scale)
        y = int((event.y - y0) / scale)

        if x < 0 or y < 0 or x >= iw or y >= ih:
            return

        label = int(self.segmentation.label_map[y, x])
        if label == 0:
            self.status.set("Clicked on a line/non-fillable area. Try inside a closed region.")
            return

        if label in self.segmentation.border_labels:
            self.status.set("Clicked on a border/background region (outside). Not fillable by default.")
            return

        active_group['regions'].add(label)
        
        self._apply_overlay_for_region(label, active_group['color'])
        self._refresh_display()
        self._update_region_list()
        self.status.set(f"Added Region {label} to group '{active_group['name']}'.")

    def _apply_overlay_for_region(
        self, region_id: int, rgba: Tuple[int, int, int, int]
    ):
        if self.segmentation is None or self.overlay_image is None:
            return
        mask_bool = numpy_mask_from_label(self.segmentation.label_map, region_id)
        mask_L = pil_mask_from_bool(mask_bool)
        color_img = Image.new("RGBA", self.overlay_image.size, rgba)
        self.overlay_image.paste(color_img, (0, 0), mask_L)

    def clear_fills(self):
        if self.base_image is None:
            return
        self.color_groups.clear()
        self.overlay_image = Image.new("RGBA", self.base_image.size, (0, 0, 0, 0))
        self._refresh_display()
        self._update_region_list()
        self.status.set("Cleared all fills and groups.")

        # Fit to canvas while preserving aspect
        cw = max(self.canvas.winfo_width(), 1)
        ch = max(self.canvas.winfo_height(), 1)
        iw, ih = comp.size

        scale = min(cw / iw, ch / ih) if iw > 0 and ih > 0 else 1
        self.display_scale = scale

        disp = comp.resize((int(iw * scale), int(ih * scale)), Image.Resampling.BILINEAR)
        self.tk_img = ImageTk.PhotoImage(disp)
        self.canvas.delete("all")

    def on_canvas_resize(self, event):

    def _update_region_list(self):

        # Clear existing items

        # Add current fills
        for region_id, rgba in sorted(self.fills.items()):
            color_hex = f"#{rgba[0]:02x}{rgba[1]:02x}{rgba[2]:02x}"
            self.region_tree.insert("", "end", text=f"Region {region_id}", values=(color_hex,), iid=str(region_id))

    def _on_region_select(self, event):
        selection = self.region_tree.selection()
        if not selection:
            return
        
        region_id_str = selection[0]
        self.last_clicked_region = int(region_id_str)
        self.status.set(f"Region {self.last_clicked_region} selected from list.")
        # Optional: Add highlighting logic here in the future
        # self._highlight_region(self.last_clicked_region)

    def pick_color(self):
        initial = "#%02x%02x%02x" % self.current_color[:3]
        color_info = colorchooser.askcolor(title="Pick fill color", color=initial)
        if color_info and color_info[0]:
            r, g, b = color_info[0]
            self.current_color = (int(r), int(g), int(b), 150)

    def on_canvas_click(self, event):
        if self.base_image is None or self.segmentation is None:
            return
        # Map canvas coords -> image coords
        cw = max(self.canvas.winfo_width(), 1)
        ch = max(self.canvas.winfo_height(), 1)
        iw, ih = self.base_image.size
        scale = self.display_scale

        # Image is centered; compute top-left corner
        disp_w, disp_h = int(iw * scale), int(ih * scale)
        x0 = (cw - disp_w) // 2
        y0 = (ch - disp_h) // 2

        x = int((event.x - x0) / scale)
        y = int((event.y - y0) / scale)

        if x < 0 or y < 0 or x >= iw or y >= ih:
            return

        label = int(self.segmentation.label_map[y, x])
        if label == 0:
            self.status.set(
                "Clicked on a line/non-fillable area. Try inside a closed region."
            )
            return

        if label in self.segmentation.border_labels:
            self.status.set(
                "Clicked on a border/background region (outside). Not fillable by default."
            )
            return

        self.last_clicked_region = label
        # Apply/Update fill color for this region
        self.fills[label] = self.current_color
        self._apply_overlay_for_region(label, self.current_color)
        self._refresh_display()
        self._update_region_list() # Update the side panel
        self.status.set(
            f"Filled region {label} with {self.current_color[:3]} (alpha={self.current_color[3]})."
        )

    def _apply_overlay_for_region(
        self, region_id: int, rgba: Tuple[int, int, int, int]
    ):
        """Draw the region mask into overlay_image with the given color."""
        if self.segmentation is None or self.overlay_image is None:
            return
        mask_bool = numpy_mask_from_label(self.segmentation.label_map, region_id)
        mask_L = pil_mask_from_bool(mask_bool)  # 0/255
        color_img = Image.new("RGBA", self.overlay_image.size, rgba)
        # Paste only where mask=255 (region)
        self.overlay_image.paste(color_img, (0, 0), mask_L)

    def undo_last_fill(self):
        if not self.fills:
            self.status.set("Nothing to undo.")
            return
        # Remove the most recently clicked region if available
        if self.last_clicked_region is None:
            # If last region unknown, pop arbitrary last
            if not self.fills: return
            region_id = next(reversed(self.fills))
        else:
            region_id = self.last_clicked_region

        # To undo region 'painting', we need to clear and redraw all remaining fills
        self.fills.pop(region_id, None)
        self.overlay_image = Image.new("RGBA", self.base_image.size, (0, 0, 0, 0))
        for rid, rgba in self.fills.items():
            self._apply_overlay_for_region(rid, rgba)

        self._refresh_display()
        self._update_region_list() # Update the side panel
        self.status.set(f"Undo fill for region {region_id}.")
        # Reset last clicked if we removed it
        self.last_clicked_region = None

    def clear_fills(self):
        if self.base_image is None:
            return
        self.fills.clear()
        self.overlay_image = Image.new("RGBA", self.base_image.size, (0, 0, 0, 0))
        self._refresh_display()
        self._update_region_list() # Update the side panel
        self.status.set("Cleared all fills.")

def _rename_selected_group(self):
        if not self.region_tree: return
        selection = self.region_tree.selection()
        if not selection or not selection[0].startswith("group_"):
            messagebox.showwarning("Warning", "Please select a group folder to rename.")
            return
        
        group_id = selection[0]
        group = next((g for g in self.color_groups if g['id'] == group_id), None)
        if not group: return

        new_name = tk.simpledialog.askstring("Rename Group", "Enter new name:", initialvalue=group['name'], parent=self)
        if new_name:
            group['name'] = new_name
            self._update_region_list()

    def _delete_selected_group(self):
        if not self.region_tree: return
        selection = self.region_tree.selection()
        if not selection or not selection[0].startswith("group_"):
            messagebox.showwarning("Warning", "Please select a group folder to delete.")
            return

        group_id = selection[0]
        if not messagebox.askyesno("Confirm Delete", f"Are you sure you want to delete the group '{self.region_tree.item(group_id, 'text')}' and all its regions?"):
            return

        self.color_groups = [g for g in self.color_groups if g['id'] != group_id]
        
        self._redraw_all_overlays()
        self._refresh_display()
        self._update_region_list()
        self.status.set(f"Deleted group.")

    def _remove_selected_region(self):
        if not self.region_tree: return
        selection = self.region_tree.selection()
        if not selection or not selection[0].startswith("region_"):
            messagebox.showwarning("Warning", "Please select a region area (e.g., 'Area 5') to remove.")
            return

        region_iid = selection[0]
        region_id = int(region_iid.split('_')[1])
        parent_iid = self.region_tree.parent(region_iid)

        group = next((g for g in self.color_groups if g['id'] == parent_iid), None)
        if group and region_id in group['regions']:
            group['regions'].remove(region_id)
            
            self._redraw_all_overlays()
            self._refresh_display()
            self._update_region_list()
            self.status.set(f"Removed Region {region_id} from group '{group['name']}'.")

    def _redraw_all_overlays(self):
        """Helper to clear and redraw the entire color overlay from scratch."""
        if self.base_image is None: return
        self.overlay_image = Image.new("RGBA", self.base_image.size, (0, 0, 0, 0))
        for group in self.color_groups:
            for region_id in group['regions']:
                self._apply_overlay_for_region(region_id, group['color'])

    # ---------- PDF Loading & Rendering ----------

def _apply_overlay_for_region(
        self, region_id: int, rgba: Tuple[int, int, int, int]
    ):
        if self.segmentation is None or self.overlay_image is None:
            return
        mask_bool = numpy_mask_from_label(self.segmentation.label_map, region_id)
        mask_L = pil_mask_from_bool(mask_bool)
        color_img = Image.new("RGBA", self.overlay_image.size, rgba)
        self.overlay_image.paste(color_img, (0, 0), mask_L)

        # --- Draw Region ID Text ---
        # Find center of mass to place the text
        center_y, center_x = ndi.center_of_mass(mask_bool)
        
        # Determine text color (black or white) based on fill color brightness
        brightness = (rgba[0] * 299 + rgba[1] * 587 + rgba[2] * 114) / 1000
        text_color = (0, 0, 0, 255) if brightness > 128 else (255, 255, 255, 255)

        # Draw text on the overlay
        draw = ImageDraw.Draw(self.overlay_image)
        try:
            # Try to use a slightly larger font
            font = ImageFont.truetype("arial.ttf", 24)
        except IOError:
            font = ImageFont.load_default()
        
        text = str(region_id)
        text_bbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=font)
        text_w = text_bbox[2] - text_bbox[0]
        text_h = text_bbox[3] - text_bbox[1]
        
        draw.text(
            (center_x - text_w / 2, center_y - text_h / 2),
            text,
            font=font,
            fill=text_color
        )

from PIL import Image, ImageTk, ImageOps, ImageDraw, ImageFont
